subject: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tu <alex.tu@pinebridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request

Alex / team — looping you in to set the weekly runway conversation cadence. Pinebridge’s pilot (DEAL PB-2026-0821) is ramping next month and we need to lock a short runway for Dedicated + burst mix so infra and finance can commit. Attached: pinebridge_pilot_capacity_request.xlsx (sheet: weekly-forecast).

Quick highlights from our intake: 
- Pilot window: 2027-01-04 -> 2027-03-31 (8-12 week active pilot with staging)
- Expected steady state tokens/day (estimate): 4.5M tokens/day
- Peak sequences: 6k concurrent requests at test peak, typical latency SLO 150-250ms
- Rough equivalent: 6 A100-eq reserved + 4 A100-eq burst in high weeks (need final infra sizing)

Requests / asks: 
1) Laura / Monica: want a finance sketch of committed monthly spend + short note on credit/discount needed to sign for a 3-month reserved block.
2) Karthik: can infra confirm a feasible split between reserved capacity and burst slots for Jan-Feb given the current fleet commitments? Any constraints (maintenance, region) to call out?
3) Alex / procurement: can you confirm preferred procurement timeline and whether DocuSign approval by 11/22 is possible?

Proposed next steps: 30m sync this Thursday 11/12 or Friday 11/13 (I’ll send a meeting invite once folks confirm). I’m aiming to get a 3-month reserve commitment option + burst budget locked to avoid losing the pilot window.

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive 
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: pinebridge_pilot_capacity_request.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Alex Tu <alex.tu@pinebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request

Ben — thanks for the clear intake. Quick finance read: based on the attached sheet and our unit economics, a 3-month reserved block of 6 A100-equivalents would be roughly $216,000/month pre-discount. With a pilot-focused discount (15%) we can propose $183,600/month.

Questions I have for accuracy: 
- Is the ~6 A100-eq reserved a hard lower bound, or can infra operate on 4 reserved + 6 burst for predictable weeks? That materially changes the cash commit and our preferred discount cadence.
- Do we have a clear estimate of sustained token throughput per hour vs. instantaneous burst? The cost cadence in our model uses average sustained tokens to size batching and slot mix.

If we go for a 3-month reserved commitment, finance wants a signed DocuSign by 11/22 and a PO or a simple SOW attached. Monica — can you draft a quick price summary for Ben to share?

On scheduling: Thursday 11/12 11:00–11:30 PT works for me.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance (Revenue)
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Alex Tu <alex.tu@pinebridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pinebridge.com>, Samir Das <samir.das@pinebridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request

Thanks Ben — appreciate the proactive plan. A few clarifications from our side before Thursday’s sync: 
- Pilot timeline confirmed but may front-load user load in week 2 and week 6 of the pilot (week 2 = heavier). We want a flexible burst model for those spikes.
- Procurement: we can get a provisional PO within 7 business days of receiving an itemized quote. DocuSign by 11/22 is tight but achievable if pricing and SOW are final by next Wednesday.
- Technical ask: we’d prefer region us-west for lower latency to our end-users, can you confirm availability in that region?

I’ve looped procurement and Samir (CFO) for budgetary signoff — Samir, happy to jump on the Thursday sync if helpful.

Best,
Alex Tu
Head of Engineering
Pinebridge Systems
alex.tu@pinebridge.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Alex Tu <alex.tu@pinebridge.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request

Ben / team — infra runbook read below after reviewing the workbook and running a short capacity simulation. Summary: 
- Usable capacity in us-west across committed pools the week of Jan 03: 42 A100-eq total (after planned maintenance windows). Current reserved commitments already allocated: 28 A100-eq. That leaves ~14 A100-eq cushion for bursts or new reserved pools.
- For Pinebridge pilot, recommended configuration: 
  * Reserve 4 A100-eq in us-west for baseline (guaranteed throughput, lowers unit cost)
  * Provision 6 A100-eq as burst slots attached to the same route, with autoscale policy for quick spin-up. Burst slots consume capacity from the cushion during high weeks.
  * Add KV-cache prefixes and prefix caching to reduce token compute. We estimate this lowers effective peak GPU minutes by ~18% for the pilot workload.

Notes / risks: 
- If other deals finalize reserved commits before 12/15, us-west cushion could shrink to 6 A100-eq; we need a decision on Pinebridge commit by 11/22 to hold capacity.
- There’s a maintenance window scheduled 2027-02-09 01:00–05:00 PT that will reduce available GPU minutes; recommend we avoid critical rollout that night.

I’ll drop the infra runbook link in the meeting invite (runbook: /internal/runbooks/pilot-capacity-allocations).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Tu <alex.tu@pinebridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@pinebridge.com>, Samir Das <samir.das@pinebridge.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinebridge pilot — weekly GPU runway & finops signoff request

Thanks everyone — aligned and next steps below.

Summary of decisions: 
- Infra recommends 4 A100-eq reserved + 6 A100-eq burst in us-west, with prefix caching to reduce peak compute needs. (Karthik: noted maintenance window 2027-02-09)
- Finance: preliminary pricing at $183.6k/month with pilot discount (Laura) — final pricing doc attached (proposal_v2.pdf).
- Procurement: requested PO timeline looks feasible; DocuSign goal still 11/22.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Alex / Pinebridge: confirm PO timeline and whether you want us to include a monthly burst budget cap in the SOW (due 11/18).
- Monica: prepare one-page price summary and the DocuSign envelope (Monica to Laura) by 11/17.
- Karthik: reserve the 4 A100-eq slot in us-west tentatively to hold capacity pending signoff; confirm if cushion drops before 11/22 (by 11/20).
- Ben: will send the meeting invite for Thursday 11/19 11:00–11:30 PT to finalize SOW & DocuSign routing.

I’ve attached the updated proposal and the capacity workbook with the labelled assumptions. If Pinebridge can confirm the PO cadence and whether a monthly burst cap is required, we’ll finalize the DocuSign envelope and route it to Samir for signature.

See you on Thursday —
Ben
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposal_v2.pdf, pinebridge_pilot_capacity_request.xlsx
